verdict.rationale: The pack documents no data-retention policy, retention period settings, or account or data deletion controls in a privacy sense. Two items come close but don't count. The admin switch that blocks Copilot from deleting records and configuration is an adjacent permission control, not retention or deletion management. The API's ability to delete records is a developer building block. Neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
